questions.text: What does a normal Tuesday look like for you right now?

What are you watching, reading or playing these days?

What's something everyone around you is talking about right now?
What did you eat today?
What's a goal you're scared to say out loud?
What do you hope you've started by the time you read this?
What do you hope you've stopped doing by the time you read this?

Who do you miss?
